criterion_fired: CRITERION 2 (Carry-forward Consistency) and CRITERION 4 (Actionable Next Steps)
suggested_change: CRITERION 2: 'Reassessments are permitted if driven by new call information OR by logical synthesis across multiple calls. Document the reasoning. Carry-forward constraint applies only when data is truly static across calls.' CRITERION 4: 'Next steps must be specific and actionable. Retroactive rewording of prior analysis is not required unless the prior step was explicitly vague in the original output.'
